captions.IG:
Bariatric counseling San Antonio testimonials

'The staff never made me feel judged.'

Samantha F., BCC Alumna, describes her experience at the Bariatric Counseling Center. We offer an innovative program designed to help people who struggle with weight loss, obesity, binge eating and chronic overeating.

Our team provides behavioral therapy, dietary guidance, culinary classes and mindful movement. One program, not four.

San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BariatricCounseling #VirtualTherapyTexas #BariatricSupport
